sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text:
- 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from The Extortionist.
- 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from The Survivalist Path - Unprotected but Dangerous.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: - These are usually surplus AKM rifles, Smooth-bored or entirely rebarreled to .366 (or 9.55mm) by a factory (such as Molot) which can then be certified, sold and registered under a shotgun license in Russia e.g. to hunters, which is much easier to obtain.
